editorial:
The Vigilantes Are Coming is a 12-chapter Republic Pictures serial directed by Ray Taylor and Mack V. Wright. It starred Robert Livingston as Don Loring, a masked vigilante called The Eagle, with Kay Hughes, Guinn 'Big Boy' Williams, Raymond Hatton and Fred Kohler in support. Per Wikipedia's Production section, it was filmed between 28 May and 17 June 1936 under the working title 'The Vigilantes'. Wikipedia's Release section gives 22 August 1936 as the official release date, and notes this is actually the date the sixth chapter was made available to film exchanges. Wikipedia's chapter list gives running times from about 15 to 31 minutes, and its Stunts section credits Yakima Canutt as Don Loring, doubling Robert Livingston. A creator gets a complete B-western cliffhanger, which suits clip reels and serial-themed compilations.

The rights trap is that the print's status is unconfirmed. The 1963 and 1965 Catalog of Copyright Entries searches covered only part of each volume, the 1964 search was not re-confirmed, and the Copyright Office public records were not checked. Wikipedia also says the serial reworks Valentino's The Eagle (1925), and the rights in that source were not examined. Check the Copyright Office record yourself before treating the print as free. Any score on a particular upload and any franchise or character mark would need separate clearance.
faq: Is The Vigilantes Are Coming public domain?

Not confirmed. No renewal line was found in the searches of the 1963-1965 Catalog of Copyright Entries motion-picture volumes, but those searches were partial or not re-confirmed, and the Copyright Office public records were not searched. Do that search before relying on the print.
Does the Internet Archive copy clear me to reuse it?
No. The Internet Archive upload is a user upload, listed as uploaded in 2021. An upload shows the film is available, not that its copyright status was checked. Confirm the renewal position yourself.
